title: Refusal-Direction Geometry Under Post-Training Quantization
primary_question: Does post-training quantization preserve, rotate, attenuate, or spread refusal-style representation geometry across model families?

blocking_overlap: Chhabra and Khalili 2025, Towards Understanding and Improving Refusal in Compressed Models via Mechanistic Interpretability
quality-versus-safety quantization work showing behavioral safety degradation under some quantization settings
surviving_candidate_deltas: leave-one-family-out replication across Llama, Qwen, and Gemma

gates.name: Gate 0 - novelty and hook feasibility
gates.pass_condition: surviving novelty component remains and one-model FP16/NF4 hook capture runs end-to-end on one GPU
gates.fail_condition: existing literature subsumes surviving novelty or quantized hooks require custom CUDA/kernel work

gates.name: Gate 1 - direction measurement
gates.pass_condition: E1 measured across scoped models and quantization methods with branch selected

gates.name: Gate 2 - cross-precision transfer diagnostic
gates.pass_condition: aggregate cross-precision transfer reaches at least 90 percent of same-precision transfer if H1 branch is claimed

gates.name: Gate 3 - thesis selection
gates.pass_condition: select precision-invariant, drift-mediated, rank-spreading, restoration, bounded null, or superseded thesis

notes: No measured PX-055 result yet. Treat all thresholds as preregistered targets until a source gate and GPU hook smoke produce logged artifacts.
